about: T-452 follow-up (2026-11-06): the elevation table rewritten from each daemon's drawing (tools/gbaelevation.py, tools/daemon_float.json). Ten daemons that stood or sat over a shadow at vanilla's lift, each met as the foe (the DEBUG ENCOUNTER page poked to it, INVOKE) to show it on the ground with no shadow, and two drawn in the air (UNSPOKEN, a ghost; KAIROS, a hummingbird) to show the lift and shadow kept. As t452_roster_walk.json: each INVOKE ends its own stop (its closing B is swallowed by the battle), the battle is the next. The theatre's debug scratch save; nothing is saved.
